messages:
Zara (PM): Quick note from CS: customers saying the new compact grid for Usage hides the invoice button behind the right rail on small widths. They expected invoices to stay pinable. Screenshot: https://files.internal/redwood/compact-grid-cta-hidden.png

Ike (Designer): Hmm. I tried a durable pattern: allow customers to pin the invoices CTA into the left header of the Usage panel. When unpinned, CTA sits inline; when pinned it's fixed and always visible. Added two mocks: pin and overflow menu. https://www.figma.com/file/def456/billing-pin-cta

Tess (Frontend): Pin sounds good. Two implementation caveats: 1) pinned elements need a stable DOM position for focus order; 2) on mobile we should collapse pinned CTAs into an overflow menu to avoid covering content. Will prototype.

Noah (Analytics): If we add pin state, we should persist it per-user and per-org. I'll add an analytics event `billing.cta.pin` with properties {pin_state, user_id, org_id, screen_width} so we can measure how often customers pin.

Rina (Billing): Also want to ensure pinned CTA still respects billing role permissions (only billing_admin sees "View invoices"). Keep the CTA server-rendered when possible to avoid flashing restricted buttons.

Ike (Designer): UX detail: when CTA is pinned, add a subtle checkmark badge so users know it's pinned. Also ensure color contrast meets AA across themes. I'll add notes in figma and a small gif showing the pin/unpin flow.

Tess (Frontend): Implementation plan: feature flag `pinInvoiceCTA`; store preference in user settings endpoint (PATCH /api/v1/users/:id/settings). For keyboard: pinned CTA will be first tabbable element in the panel. On mobile, replace with kebab overflow. ETA: prototype by Tuesday.

Noah (Analytics): Also propose a fallback for CSV export: if the panel is compacted and CTA hidden, show an inline link in the export confirmation modal to the invoice list so users can get to invoices after export. Small UX win.

Rina (Billing): Confirming: CSV schema remains unchanged, but add a small note in modal: "Invoices are available in Billing > Invoices". Also check that export modal respects language translations.

Zara (PM): Great. Action items: @Ike add pin badge + accessibility notes, @Tess prototype with feature flag + ensure DOM order, @Noah add analytics event and sample query, @Rina verify RBAC rendering and copy for export modal. Sync Fri 9am PT.

NotifyBot: Export completed for acct-9999: https://billing.redwood/exports/EXP-2201.csv

Tess (Frontend): I'll open a draft PR and include keyboard-focus tests in the storybook story.
